english.note: Use this when the foolishness consists specifically of doing stupid or ill-judged things rather than merely behaving foolishly.

examples.english: You fool around by borrowing from loan sharks to chase girls.
examples.traditional: 為咗追女仔去借貴利，你真係做傻事喎。
